sign_top: Wild Spirlings nest in the ferns.
Walk through them and one may step out.

lines: Wedged behind the rock: two Kin Charms!
Just moss behind the rock now.
Your partner gets Energy back every turn.
If it runs dry, let it rest a turn. No shame in that!
I'd love to see a Breezel up close. They tumble past too fast on the ridge.
Your Breezel nearly blew my hat off. Worth it!
You look new at this. Take these!
Bonding works best when a Spirling is worn down.
Tap with the pulse and it may trust you.
